aiTraining.title: Training
aiTraining.sub: Teach the agents how the shop talks and decides, in your own words. Every change is a new version, and you can bring back an older one.
aiTraining.needPermission: You can read this page. Teaching the agents needs the AI control permission.
aiTraining.aiOff: AI is off. What you write here is saved and kept; the agents use it once AI is turned on.
aiTraining.rules: Instructions guide how an agent writes and decides. They never override the standing rules: replies to buyers stay on Ask, deletes wait for your approval, and no agent changes permissions.

instr.d: One instruction per line, for every agent or for one.
instr.placeholder: For example: write replies short and warm, in Bengali first.
instr.added: Instruction saved as a new version
instr.failed: Could not save. Someone may have saved first: reload the page and try again.
instr.removed: Instruction removed as a new version

forbidden.d: Topics no agent may bring up.
forbidden.added: Topic saved as a new version
forbidden.failed: Could not save. Someone may have saved first: reload the page and try again.
forbidden.removed: Topic removed as a new version

ver.d: Every save is a version. Restoring one saves it again as the newest version; nothing is deleted.
ver.failed: Could not restore. Someone may have saved first: reload the page and try again.
ver.none: No versions yet. The first save makes version 1.
ver.more: Showing the newest {shown} of {total}. Older versions are kept.

opt.d: How many versions the history shows. Every version is kept either way.
opt.readOnly: You can see this choice. Changing it needs the AI control permission.

err.STALE: Someone saved first. The page shows their value; check and save again.
err.INVALID_INPUT: A number is out of range.

try.d: Type a sample message and see what the agent would answer with the instructions above. Nothing is sent to anyone and nothing is saved until you press the button below the answer.
try.samplePh: For example: Where is my order?
try.off: AI is off, so nothing was tried. Turn AI on to test an agent; no model was called.
try.unavailable: The agent could not answer now (paused, no connection ready, or the monthly limit is reached). Nothing was sent.
try.betterPh: Change the answer the way you want it.

note.d: Write what an agent got wrong, in your own words. It is saved as a note for you and your team; no AI is called.
note.placeholder: For example: the support agent promised a refund date.

doc.d: Reference notes the agent may use, such as a size guide or a returns explanation. Editing saves a new version; older versions are kept.
doc.title: Title
doc.textPh: Paste or type the reference text.
